# WebEyeTrack attribution

The Blaze-style PyTorch ablation in modelv1/blaze_style_model.py adapts the
BlazeBlock and CNN topology from:

- Project: WebEyeTrack
- Source: https://github.com/RedForestAI/WebEyeTrack
- Reference file: python/webeyetrack/blazegaze.py
- License: MIT; see LICENSE in this directory

The TensorFlow source, pretrained weights, preprocessing pipeline, MAML
training, and browser runtime are not vendored into this repository.
